description: We are BRAC University CSE students who are deeply curious about space exploration and always wanted to relive historic NASA missions. To recreate the closest experience possible, we built Galactic Archive: an immersive, browser-based space mission design game. By blending tech, art, and real-world debriefs, we are offering the players to relive the glorious missions of NASA and explore the future.

details: The sheer purpose of the project is to demonstrate the users about the glorious missions of NASA. The users can experience the high-stake decisions during these missions. The project is based on JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Python. The images and video are made by SI to make the project more interactive by the users. To make this project, we considered the high-stake decision making as well as the adrenaline-fueled gameplay to make the project as interactive as possible with the accuracy of the NASA missions so that the users can relive the missions by themselves instead of stories. We have implemented visual storytelling for their experiences.
